summary: Build request/emitter selection, manifest backend tags, exact companion output comparison, four-app CLI artifacts, unsupported-backend rejection, and legacy identity checks passed review. Found one concrete regression: exported zero-valued GobiBackend.Emit panics because the newly added emitter interface is nil; the base implementation returned an AppIR validation error. R-BUILD should add a nil-emitter guard and regression test.

findings.summary: GobiBackend.Emit panics when called on a non-nil zero-valued exported adapter because emitter is nil.
findings.recommended_gate: Reject nil/unconfigured emitter with an error and add a zero-value regression test.

limits: No production or contract files were changed during review.
The four-app browser swap matrix remains outside this Go build-lane review.
